content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect handling of reservation properties for different reservation types (Group, Curriculum, Course) in the `XReservation` class. Specifically, the code was using the same individual reservation properties for all types instead of the appropriate group, curriculum, or course-specific properties. This led to incorrect behavior when managing reservations, as the system did not respect the intended configurations for each reservation type. The patch corrected this by ensuring that the correct properties are set based on the reservation type, thus fixing the issue introduced in a previous commit.
